data.summary: This chain reports 2 stages, each on the rows the stage before it returns; its last stage reports 1 aggregation across 2 groups from 2 of 100 records, with 1 whole-chain overlay.
sentences: This chain reports 2 stages, each on the rows the stage before it returns; its last stage reports 1 aggregation across 2 groups from 2 of 100 records, with 1 whole-chain overlay.
Stage 1 reports 1 aggregation across 2 groups from 90 of 100 records.
Stage 1's aggregation 1 `total` runs AGG_SUM on `revenue`. Total of a numeric field, over all rows or per group. It read 90 rows and left out 0 with no value.
Stage 1's run read 100 records; 90 passed the filters and 0 were left out for a missing value.
Stage 2 reports 1 aggregation across 2 groups from 2 of 100 records.
Stage 2's aggregation 1 `avg` runs AGG_AVERAGE on `total`. Average of a numeric field, over all rows or per group. It read 2 rows and left out 0 with no value.
Stage 2's run read 100 records; 2 passed the filters and 0 were left out for a missing value.
The chain's overlay 1 (OVERLAY_INDEX_VS_STAGE) `growth` describes the host's values; it carries no p-value.
